title: US Presidential Election 1996
description: Bill Clinton re-elected as US President, maintaining political continuity.

title: US Presidential Election 2000
description: George W. Bush wins a contested election against Al Gore after Supreme Court intervention, causing some market uncertainty.

title: China Joins WTO
description: China officially becomes a member of the World Trade Organization, integrating into the global economy and altering global supply chains.

title: US Presidential Election 2004
description: George W. Bush re-elected as US President.

title: US Presidential Election 2008
description: Barack Obama elected as US President during the Global Financial Crisis.

title: Dodd-Frank Act
description: Obama signs the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, tightening financial regulations.

title: 2011 US Debt Ceiling Crisis
description: Budget Control Act passed after a standoff that led to the first-ever downgrade of the US credit rating, sparking a major gold rally.

title: US Presidential Election 2012
description: Barack Obama re-elected as US President.

title: 2013 US Government Shutdown
description: A 16-day federal government shutdown due to disputes over the Affordable Care Act funding.

title: Narendra Modi Takes Office (India)
description: Narendra Modi becomes Prime Minister of India, introducing pro-business economic reforms.

title: Brexit Referendum
description: The UK votes to leave the European Union, causing massive shockwaves in global markets and a flight to safety (gold).

title: US Presidential Election 2016
description: Donald Trump elected as US President, promising trade protectionism and America First policies.

title: US Withdraws from TPP
description: President Trump signs an executive order withdrawing the US from the Trans-Pacific Partnership.

title: UK Triggers Article 50
description: The UK formally initiates the process of withdrawing from the EU.

title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA)
description: Major US tax reform signed by Donald Trump, significantly lowering the corporate tax rate.

title: US Tariffs on Solar Panels and Washing Machines
description: First major tariffs of the Trump administration, beginning the global trade wars.

title: US Section 301 Tariffs Announced
description: Trump signs a memorandum directing tariffs on $50 billion of Chinese goods.

title: First Round of US-China Tariffs
description: US implements 25% tariffs on $34 billion of Chinese imports. China retaliates.

title: Second Round of US-China Tariffs
description: US implements 25% tariffs on an additional $16 billion of Chinese imports.

title: Third Round of US-China Tariffs
description: US imposes 10% tariffs on $200 billion of Chinese imports.

title: USMCA Agreement Reached
description: US, Mexico, and Canada agree to a new trade deal to replace NAFTA.

title: Jair Bolsonaro Elected (Brazil)
description: Right-wing candidate Jair Bolsonaro wins the Brazilian presidential election.

title: 2018-2019 US Government Shutdown
description: Start of a 35-day government shutdown over border wall funding.

title: US Increases Tariffs on China
description: US increases tariffs on $200 billion of Chinese goods from 10% to 25%.

title: 2019 European Parliament Election
description: Elections across the EU show a fragmented parliament but pro-EU majority holds.

title: Fourth Round of US-China Tariffs (List 4A)
description: US imposes 15% tariffs on $112 billion of Chinese goods. China retaliates with tariffs on US crude oil.

title: US-China Phase One Trade Deal
description: US and China sign an agreement to pause the trade war and roll back some tariffs.

title: Brexit Day
description: The UK officially leaves the European Union, entering a transition period.

title: CARES Act
description: US passes $2.2 trillion stimulus package in response to COVID-19, driving major fiscal expansion.

title: USMCA Enters into Force
description: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement officially replaces NAFTA.

title: US Presidential Election 2020
description: Joe Biden elected as US President.

title: RCEP Signed
description: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership signed by 15 Asia-Pacific nations, creating the world's largest free trade bloc.

title: UK-EU Trade and Cooperation Agreement
description: Post-Brexit trade deal agreed between the UK and EU just days before the deadline.

title: American Rescue Plan Act
description: $1.9 trillion stimulus package passed by the Biden administration.

title: Inflation Reduction Act
description: Significant US climate, tax, and healthcare bill signed into law.

title: Lula Elected (Brazil)
description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva wins the Brazilian presidential election, defeating Jair Bolsonaro.

title: Recep Tayyip Erdogan Re-elected (Turkey)
description: Erdogan secures another term, affecting Turkish monetary policy and lira stability.

title: Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023
description: Bill passed to suspend the US debt ceiling and avoid a sovereign default.

title: SEC Approves Spot Bitcoin ETFs
description: US SEC officially approves 11 spot Bitcoin ETFs, a landmark regulatory shift for crypto competing with gold.

title: Claudia Sheinbaum Elected (Mexico)
description: Sheinbaum wins a landslide victory, ensuring continuity of Morena party policies.

title: Narendra Modi Wins Third Term (India)
description: Modi secures a third term but with a reduced majority, relying on coalition partners.

title: 2024 European Parliament Election
description: Right-wing parties make significant gains in EU parliament elections.

title: US Presidential Election 2024
description: Donald Trump wins the 2024 presidential election, securing a second non-consecutive term.

title: Trump 2025 Inauguration
description: Donald Trump sworn in, immediately initiating sweeping executive orders on trade and deregulation.

title: Trump Announces Baseline Universal Tariffs
description: Trump administration formally announces baseline 10-20% tariffs on all imported goods.

title: Trump Announces 60% Tariffs on China
description: Severe escalation in the US-China trade war with sweeping 60% tariffs implemented on Chinese imports.

title: US Reciprocal Trade Act Enforcement
description: US begins heavily enforcing reciprocal tariffs on countries with trade surpluses against the US.

title: Comprehensive Crypto Deregulation Framework
description: Passage of major pro-crypto regulatory framework in the US, altering the safe-haven dynamic between gold and digital assets.
